title: POST /hitch/v1/person/:op
description: A person-client calls a person-only operation directly (the person acts in their own client, so this is a signed command, not a decision; the revoke precedent). `op` must equal the path's op and come from catalogue personOps, which fixes each op's tier, body schema and secret fields. Person-clients only (not_a_client otherwise). Tier, suite and presence are checked as for answers; presence signs JCS(call minus presence). iat/exp ≤ 120 s, nonce single-use (replay). An op with secret fields is tier local, so it travels only over the socket or loopback, and its secrets never reach an event, an audit line or a log. The audit keeps op, client, outcome and a hash of the non-secret fields. `for` names the decision this call answers in place (e.g. a session's kernel.connector.signin@1): the node resolves it as applied by this client, if the op's personOps row lists that kind in `closes`.
